text:
selena: Kicking off canary for release/2026-04-01 — routing 6% to embeddings.route. Change window 09:00-13:00 PT. I'll watch SLOs for 20m. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-04-01 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started — job=canary-2026-04-01-6pct, target=embeddings.route, routing=6% :rocket:

devin: Observability: embeddings.route p95 spiked to ~1.2s at 1718123490 (baseline ~260ms). 5xx rate moved 0.1% -> 1.8% over 4m. dashboard: https://obs.redwood/dash/embeds

sre-oncall: Alert firing: slo_alert(embeds/p95>800ms,5m) for canary tag. Can you paste the alert filter?

devin: Query: ```
err = sum(rate(http_responses_total{route=\"/v1/embeddings\",code!~\"2..\",deploy_tag=\"canary\"}[5m]))
req = sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v1/embeddings\",deploy_tag=\"canary\"}[5m]))
err/req > 0.01
```

ion: Traces show upstream 503s with worker logs: "alloc failure, kill signal" and many long queue times. Looks like batcher produced huge batches hitting memory limits on a subset of canary nodes.

selena: Pause canary and increase trace sampling. We'll triage in-pool rather than rollback if possible. /deploy pause canary job=canary-2026-04-01-6pct (requested by selena)

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Routing set to 0%. Traces sampling increased. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-04-01/1718123505

ion: Propose hotfix: pin embeddings.model to "emb-v1.2.7" for canary and set batcher.max_batch_tokens=1024 (down from 4096). That should avoid large allocations.

selena: I like pin+limit. Apply config patch and run synthetic probe at 5rps for 90s.

deploy-bot: Applied config-change-1718123530. Starting synthetic-probe job=synthetic-verify-1718123535 at 5 rps for 90s.

devin: Synthetic looks stable — p95 ~280ms, errors 0.03%. No 503s in traces.

sre-oncall: Good. Plan: resume a conservative ramp to 2% for 10m. If p95 <450ms and err_rate <0.2% continue to 10%. If breach -> full rollback. I'll page if error_rate >0.5% or p95 >700ms.

pm-jordan: Noting customer impact window; drafting a short blurb for ops->status if we need it.

selena: Resuming to 2% now. /deploy resume canary job=canary-2026-04-01-6pct target=2% (requested by selena)

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 2%. Observability: high sampling, alert window=5m.

selena: Marking ticket REL-2026-04-01 as PAUSED->PINNED->RESUMED(2%). I'll follow up with postmortem actions: test harness for batcher max sizes, guardrails for batcher changes, and a coupling test between model variant and mem footprint. :spiral_notepad:

deploy-bot: Thread summary saved to REL-2026-04-01. Canary status: PAUSED->PINNED->RAMPED(2%). Summary logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/canary-2026-04-01/summary-1718123600

selena: Thanks everybody for fast triage. We'll reconvene if any metric drifts. :thumbsup:
